mapper.select: select (doc->'org'->'cpl')::text p from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
select coalesce(sum(secs), 0) from cpl_log where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and kind = 'beat' and day = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
select count(*)::int from cpl_log where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and kind = 'attend' and cls = #{cls} and day = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
mapper.insert: insert into cpl_log (tenant_id, sid, kind, cls, item, secs, ip, ua) values (#{tid}, #{sid}, #{kind}, #{cls}, #{item}, #{secs}, #{ip}, #{ua})
mapper.select: select sid, coalesce(sum(secs) filter (where kind = 'beat'), 0)::int secs, coalesce(sum(secs) filter (where kind = 'beat' and day = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date), 0)::int today, count(distinct ip)::int ips, to_char(max(at) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') last, (count(*) filter (where kind like 'verify-%'))::int verified from cpl_log where tenant_id = #{tid} group by sid order by max(at) desc limit 1000

select id::text id, sid, kind, cls, item, secs, ip, ua, to_char(at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') at from cpl_log where tenant_id = #{tid} and (#{sid} = '' or sid = #{sid}) order by cpl_log.id desc limit #{n}
mapper.delete: delete from learner_sessions where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and id <> #{keep}
